action.description: Added as Co-Sponsor Sen. Darby A. Hills

posted_text:
🏢 AI, Data Centers & Crypto
IL SB3578 — Your town could hit pause on new data centers

Illinois is blocking new data centers built by companies owned by or based in countries deemed ‘foreign adversaries’. The Commerce Commission, Power Agency, and Department of Commerce must sign off on energy plans to ensure the data center doesn’t strain the power grid.

July 1, 2026: Added as Co-Sponsor Sen. Darby A. Hills.
